        try:
            row_values.append(float(val) if val is not None else -float('inf'))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            row_values.append(-float('inf'))
    
    # Find the index of the maximum value
    # .index(max(...)) returns the first occurrence of the maximum value
    max_val_idx = row_values.index(max(row_values))
    
    # Get the corresponding header from the headers list
    result_header = headers[max_val_idx]
    
    # Write the literal value to column H (Column 8)
    ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=8).value = result_header

# Ensure output directory exists and save
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)",
